claims: Artemis I launched from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis I is an uncrewed mission.
Artemis I lifted off on November 16, 2022, at 1:47 a.m. EST.
Artemis I lifted off atop the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis I lifted off to begin its journey around the Moon.
The payload of Artemis I is Orion Spacecraft.
Artemis I launch was part of the Exploration Ground Systems program.
The Exploration Ground Systems program modernized the historic Pad 39B for the Artemis generation of lunar missions.
